beats.intent: The app window arrives under a one-line promise

board.end: Headline above one complete app window with the Today list
board.why: meet the whole product before zooming into any part of it

beats.intent: Click the quick-add bar; a new task slides in at the top of the list

board.start: Wide window, camera starting to push in
board.end: Camera leaned on the list, cursor on the plus, Draft launch email added at the top
text: Add a task in one click
board.why: the click on quick add is the cause; the new row is its effect

beats.intent: Click the due chip; the date menu opens

board.start: New row with a dashed No date chip, camera moving right
board.end: Date menu open under the chip, cursor travelling to Friday
board.why: the chip is the cause and the menu is the middle step, so it opens before anything is picked

beats.intent: Pick Friday; the menu closes and the chip fills with the date

board.end: Menu closed, the chip filled blue with Fri 17
board.why: the pick is the cause; the filled chip is its effect

beats.intent: Click Share; avatars appear and a toast confirms

board.start: Chip filled, cursor travelling up to the Share button
board.end: Avatar stack beside Share and the Shared with Design toast under it, clear of the Add a task bar, just before the toast leaves
board.why: the click on Share is the cause; avatars and toast are the proof

beats.intent: The camera pulls back to the full window and the closing line holds

board.start: Toast leaving, camera starting to pull back from the zoomed window
board.end: Window pushed back and dimmed, brand mark, two-line headline and a large Try Foldline free button centred and sharp
board.why: the recap is the message and the button is the ask, so the window steps back and the card holds still for the full 1.2s
